description: This Java class defines a Spring MVC controller for managing 'Featured Items' in an admin web interface. It includes endpoints for displaying, paginating, adding, and removing featured products, handling AJAX requests, and managing associated data models.

classes.name: FeaturedItemsController
classes.description: Controller managing featured product items in the admin interface, including listing, adding, and removing featured products, with AJAX support.

methods.name: displayFeaturedItems
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display list of categories for featured items.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a JSON list of featured products for pagination.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a product as a featured item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a product from the featured items.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up navigation menu context for the UI.
